name: RMK (Russian Copper Company)
verdict: Owned by its redomiciled parent Russian Copper Company Limited: Vsevolod Levin 34%, Roman Gorokhov 33%, Igor Kozhukhov 3% plus control of Torivent Ventures (30%). Private owners. Nothing found.
note: Listed as a sponsor of HC Avtomobilist on the club's sponsors page (archived 8 July 2025). Founder Igor Altushkin exited ownership in June 2023 (Interfax).
